other_conditions: Must have worked in building or construction activities for at least 90 days in the preceding 12 months
Worker must be registered with and have an active membership in the Himachal Pradesh Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board
Child of the worker must be mentally retarded/disabled and dependent on the registered worker
A one‑time registration fee is required, and renewal fee with proof of 90 days work each year after three years
benefits_summary: Provides ₹20,000 per annum to eligible workers for the care of their mentally retarded or disabled child.
